name: What should be included in a luxury home design contract?

mainEntity.name: What should a luxury home design agreement in Los Angeles include before work begins?
mainEntity.text: What should a luxury home design agreement in Los Angeles include before work begins?

acceptedAnswer.text: A strong luxury design agreement should eliminate ambiguity before the project starts. It should define exactly what services are included, such as concept development, material selections, drawings, renderings, furniture sourcing, procurement, installation, and site coordination. The agreement should also explain how revisions are handled, what triggers additional fees, and whether purchasing or trade account management is included. In Los Angeles projects, it is also useful to clarify who coordinates with the architect, engineer, contractor, and specialty vendors. Timing matters too, because delays often happen when responsibilities are not spelled out. Homeowners should look for clear language about deposits, payment schedules, cancellation terms, and the handling of custom orders. The best agreements also address storage, damage, substitutions, and what happens if the homeowner changes direction midstream. A detailed scope protects both sides and helps keep a luxury project focused on the original vision.
acceptedAnswer.description: A luxury design agreement should clearly define scope, deliverables, revision limits, timelines, fees, procurement responsibilities, and what happens if the project changes. It should also state whether the team handles purchasing, installation, site visits, and coordination with the builder and architect.
